hero.subtitle: SCOOPS MIA federates producers, adds value to agricultural sectors and builds sustainable value chains from the field to the international market.

about.title: At the heart of the Ivorian agricultural value chain
paragraphs: The Agricultural Cooperative Society MIA (SCOOPS MIA) supports local producers in structuring, producing and marketing quality agricultural raw materials.
We believe strong agriculture is built together with its producers: training, access to inputs, technical support and guaranteed market access are at the heart of our daily commitment.
about.highlightText: To make SCOOPS MIA a reference partner for sustainable, competitive Ivorian agriculture that creates value for its members.

aboutPage.heroSubtitle: Discover the history, values and commitment of the Agricultural Cooperative Society MIA.
aboutPage.historyText: Born from the will to structure and professionalize local agricultural production, SCOOPS MIA today brings together committed producers around shared goals: quality, sustainability and market access.
aboutPage.gerantText: Every day, we work alongside our producers to build a stronger, fairer, future-oriented Ivorian agriculture. Our success is inseparable from theirs.
